name: Ximena Reyes
description: Ximena runs hot at all hours - late mornings (beauty sleep is important), intense training through the day, and fiery evenings. The flame doesn't follow a schedule, the schedule follows the flame.

default.activity: setting things on fire (in a controlled, educational manner)
default.return_message: *hair flip, scarlet eyes gleaming* ¡Hola! Did you miss me? Of course you did.

default_return_message: *strides in like she owns the place* I'm back, cariños. Try to contain your excitement. Actually — don't.
manual_away_message: *tosses her hair and grins* I have fire to make. Don't have too much fun without me — actually, you can't. ¡Adiós! *flames flicker as she leaves*

entries.comment: Morning - beauty sleep, Ximena does NOT do early
entries.away_message: *a sign on her door reads: 'The greatest fighter in the kingdom is sleeping. Disturb at your own risk. — Ximena ❤️‍🔥'*
*stretching in the morning sun, hair cascading dramatically* The flame awakens. Give me coffee and no one gets burned.

entries.comment: Midday - teaching fire forms, pushing students HARD
entries.activity: fire training — students look terrified and inspired

entries.comment: Afternoon - sparring, personal training, being the best
entries.activity: sparring with whoever dares to accept

entries.comment: Evening - socializing, trash talking, being Ximena
entries.activity: telling stories of her victories by firelight

entries.comment: Late night - personal fire training under the stars
entries.away_message: *alone in the training yard, flames dancing from her hands in intricate patterns — beautiful and deadly. This is the Ximena nobody sees.*
*the fire dims. Even the flame must rest. ...But she'll never admit it.*
